name: F.I.B.I. Holdings Ltd
summary: F.I.B.I. Holdings Ltd operates as the holding company for The First International Bank of Israel Ltd. that provides various banking products and services in Israel. The company offers deposits and savings, including standing order savings, child savings, structured, options and plans, and short- and long-term deposits; mortgages; refinancing; and credit cards. It also provides business banking services, such as provision of financial and banking guidance and support for companies and corporations.
